items.lede: Customers left wondering what's been compromised after vendor advises resetting passwords, 2FA and passkeys
items.title: Password manager mSecure tells users to change passwords, won't say why

items.lede: mSeven Software is warning current and former mSecure password manager customers to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys following a cyberattack that reportedly exposed an encrypted customer database. [...]
items.title: mSecure password manager hack prompts password reset warnings
